description: Search the conferences and journals that appear in the dblp bibliography, from a stored copy of the publisher's CC0 bulk release. Returns each venue name as dblp writes it, how many records name it and the year span. Most-used first. Every answer carries data_as_of, answered_from and the licence.

query.description: Venue name or acronym, e.g. "ICLR" or "Nature"

name: search_venues

answered_from.description: Where the answer came from (stored copy)

data_as_of.description: Date of the dblp release the stored copy was built from

total.description: Total matches; null when not counted

title: Search Venues
